findings.body: The path was changed to `crates/openhuman-core` but `package = "openhuman"` was kept. If the Cargo.toml at that sub-path declares a different package name (commonly `openhuman-core` for a sub-crate), Cargo will fail to resolve the dependency and break the build. I attempted to read the vendored Cargo.toml at both the old and new paths to verify the package name, but neither lookup was available, so I cannot confirm the names match. The author should verify the sub-crate's `package.name` field matches `openhuman`.
findings.existing_code: openhuman_core = { package = "openhuman", path = "../../vendor/openhuman/crates/openhuman-core", optional = true, default-features = false, features = ["skills", "mcp", "hosting"] }
findings.title: Verify sub-crate package name matches after repointing dependency path

value.summary: The change repoints the `openhuman_core` dependency from the vendor workspace root to a sub-crate at `crates/openhuman-core`, but the `package = "openhuman"` field is unchanged.
